thread:
maya: quick heads-up — PR #8241 (model-routing fix) is blocked on approvals before tonight's cutover. CI green but infra needs one more sign-off. pinging @sam and @jordan for second eyes.

sam: on it, linking PR now — can you paste the high-level risk?

maya: small change in routing table + fallback logic. risk is brief degraded throughput if the fallback path misroutes; we added a canary flag and smoke tests. logs look clean.

jordan: looking. run the smoke script? i can run manual load if needed.

lee: i can do a quick perf check in staging in 10m. if results are fine i can give approver ok.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #8241: all checks passed (unit, integration, smoke). deploy window: 18:00 PT.

tess: FYI, if this lands we'll need a migration window for routing config push — plan to do config rollout post-merge.

maya: thanks. @lee appreciate the perf check. @jordan if you can eyeball the fallback logic and approve that's the last item.

jordan: skimmed code, left one tiny comment about a nil check. will fix and approve in a few mins.

maya: fixed comment and pushed.

jordan: approved ✅ — added a brief note on rollback steps in PR description.

sam: i'm signing off too. tagging release leads.

maya: great, thanks all — i'll merge at 17:50 PT unless any objections. leaving rollback playbook in the PR for on-call. :thumbsup:

lee: perf check looks good, 95th latency unchanged, no error spike. :thumbsup:

maya: merging now. deploy-bot, schedule canary at 18:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 18:00 PT. Notifying on-call.

jordan: nice, good job everyone.

sam: thanks — will monitor post-cutover.
